# Point-wise effective eddy viscosity, 193M (batch b010) against RANS 50M SST; replacement data of F14
# Definitions: mu_eff = -a:S*/(2|S*|^2) (Wu, Xiao, Paterson, PRF 3, 074602, 2018), a = deviatoric Reynolds stress, S* = deviatoric mean strain.
#   193M: mu_eff = rho k^1/2 L_eff cos (signed). RANS: mu_t = rho k^1/2 L_R (cos = 1 by construction, checked: min = max = 1). mu normalised by rho_inf U_inf D
#   (rho_inf = 0.88918 kg/m3 = p_exit/(R T_inf), U_inf = 86.2812 m/s, D = 7.75 mm). L = mu/(rho k^1/2)/D (193M: L_al = mu_eff/(rho k^1/2), signed). k/U_inf^2. |S*| D/U_inf.
# Mask: mode C with x/D <= 20 (estimator.py): finite values, k_193 > 0 and k_RANS > 0 (wall nodes excluded), z/D >= 0.3, jet x/D 0-3, near film 3-10, far film 10-20.
# Weights: cell volume V of the 50M grid (3.1 million point subset pts.npz). Plain volume-weighted quantiles (midpoint rule), negative values kept.
# Strain filter: only cells with |S*| D/U_inf > s0, |S*| of the 193M (variant "193"), or of both rungs (variant "both"). s0 = 0 is the unfiltered set (mask above).
# kept = kept volume fraction of the masked region; neg = volume fraction with mu_eff,193M <= 0 among kept cells; r = mu_t,RANS/mu_eff,193M over kept cells with mu_eff,193M > 0
#   (rkept = their volume fraction of the kept cells); q25/q50/q75 are volume-weighted; mu in rho_inf U_inf D units; kR,kD = median k/U_inf^2; LR,LD = median L/D; cosD = median 193M cos;
#   ratio_med = median(mu_t)/median(mu_eff) over all kept cells (negatives included).
